title: Fail closed when approval is required but no gate exists
goal: Ensure M6 never executes a policy decision requiring approval unless an ApprovalGate exists and explicitly approves the action.
context: M6Orchestrator currently enters approval flow only when requiresApproval and approvalGate are both non-nil. If a PolicyEvaluating implementation returns allowed=true and requiresApproval=true, a missing gate leaves allowed=true and permits execution.
forbidden_changes: Do not change policy decision semantics, UI, provider wiring, Skill behavior, or unrelated runtime transitions.
Do not claim test pass without CI evidence.
acceptance_criteria: requiresApproval with no gate is denied regardless of allowed bit.
Regression test proves actionDenied exists and actionExecuted does not.
Single logical commit; full test and CI results recorded separately.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if regression or CI fails.
